# APOP password rejection participates in the POP3 correction prompt

Entry 1204 adds APOP to the password-authentication methods that can prompt for a corrected password after authentication fails. In the accepted _actionAuthResponse, a rejected verification-only login fails without prompting; ordinary password login can cancel, retry, or forget the password and restart the authentication-method order. APOP remains implemented in JavaScript after the legacy C++ helper is removed in 1215. The method selection and retry source were read, but no POP3 server login or password prompt was exercised. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: POP3 authentication retry.
